Title: STRENGTH
Body: Adds {stacks} damage to every attack this character makes.

Title: DOUBLE ATTACK
Body: The next {stacks} attack this character makes deals double damage.

Title: POISON
Body: Deals {stacks} damage at the end of this character's turn, ignoring every defence, then weakens by 1.

Title: FROZEN
Body: Cannot act for {stacks} more turns - no cards, no attacks, no movement.

Title: SHIELD
Body: Absorbs the next {stacks} damage. Wiped at the start of every turn.

Title: BLOCK
Body: Reduces each of the next {stacks} hits by {amount}.

Title: PARRY
Body: Negates the damage for {stacks} hits and reflects the damage back to the attacker.

Title: ROOTED
Body: Cannot move. Attacking and playing cards still work.

Title: DOUBLE SHIELD
Body: The next {stacks} Shield this character gains is doubled.

Title: INNATE
Body: Always in hand. Never enters the draw or discard pile.

Title: COOLDOWN
Body: Unusable for {magnitude} turns after it is played.

Title: DORMANT
Body: Unusable for {magnitude} turns after you gain it.
